name: rosetta-greatest-element-of-a-list
code:
use default

greatest[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: Iterable[T]) -> T? =>
    values |> max_by(value => value)

if let biggest = greatest([3, 9, 4, 1]) then
    write_line("{biggest}")
fi

if let longest = greatest(["pear", "fig", "quince"]) then
    write_line("{longest}")
fi
fullSource:
use default

greatest[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: Iterable[T]) -> T? =>
    values |> max_by(value => value)

if let biggest = greatest([3, 9, 4, 1]) then
    write_line("{biggest}")
fi

if let longest = greatest(["pear", "fig", "quince"]) then
    write_line("{longest}")
fi
